representativeSnapshot.kind: Supabase project with Phase 1 through Phase 4 promoter migrations and native ticketing v2 applied

rowCountQueries: ticket_sales rows by event/payment state and matching ticket types
active promoter promo-code bindings and valid tracking touchpoints by event
service-role-only execute grants for checkout shadow resolver
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: Creates an additive, append-only shadow-decision table and one server-only resolver. Existing ticket sales, touchpoints, financial attributions, and commission ledger rows are not modified.

execution.resumeStrategy: All DDL is additive/idempotent. The order unique key makes shadow attribution retries return the original decision rather than rewriting it.
execution.idempotency: promoter_checkout_shadow_attributions(order_id) is unique; concurrent resolver calls compute only one preserved shadow decision for an order.

quarantine.strategy: No historical ticket sales are backfilled. Resolution runs only for newly created native checkout orders behind capture and shadow feature flags.

constraints: An attributed decision must reference a program, membership, and source; a none decision cannot carry those identities
Shadow decisions are append-only and cannot create payable commission records
Client roles have no table or resolver access
indexes: promoter_checkout_shadow_attributions(membership_id, created_at desc) where membership_id is not null
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Create orders under each precedence case: promoter promo code plus link, link only, native post CTA, expired/revoked touch, ineligible ticket, suspended membership, and self-purchase. Confirm source/reason and one non-payable row per order.

recovery.rollback: Disable event_promoter_shadow_commissions_enabled (and attribution capture if necessary). Existing shadow evidence remains immutable for review.
recovery.forwardFix: Use an additive migration for resolver or policy corrections. Do not update historical shadow decisions or create payable entries from this phase.

queries: shadow resolver execute grants include service_role and exclude anon/authenticated
no ticket_sale_attributions or promoter_commission_ledger rows are created by checkout shadow resolution
duplicate resolution for an order returns the original immutable row
promo code takes precedence over a valid first-party link touch and self-referral produces a none decision
